items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I might call him a personal friend, Henry Rush

ctx.x: What did they call him, Crowback or something? Crowback? Did you ever hear that nickname, Henry Rush?
Covett, Henry Rush, yeah. I might call him a personal friend, Henry Rush, he was a drummer.
Yeah, well he was telling us about it.
